findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: Observed walk in freezer to have ice accumulation to be present under fan unit. Discussed with PIC, freezer will be serviced. Ensure equipment is working at manufactures level.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed dish machine to test at 0 ppm CL. Discussed with PIC, dish machine will be serviced. Facility will continue to use dish machine, but will be using the triple sink to sanitize all dishes. Ensure dish machine is working up to the manufactures standards and at the proper concentration (100ppm CL).
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).

findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.comment: Observed multiple drawers holding cleaned utensil to have food debris accumulation. Discussed with PIC, drawers will be cleaned and utensil will be put through the wash, rinse, and sanitize process. Ensure all clean utensil are stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(A) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (A) Except as specified in (D) of this section, cleaned EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, laundered LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Observed a leak to be present at the back triple sink. Discussed with PIC, leak will be serviced. Ensure a licensed plumber services leak and facility to continue to monitor plumbing for any possible leaks.
findings.citation_text: 5-202.11(A) Approved System and Cleanable Fixtures. (A) A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to LAW.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Observed caulking to be in a state of disrepair in the following locations:
1) Black mold was observed to be present at the caulking to the left of the dish machine. 
2) Caulking was observed to be soiled with food debris at the back kitchen hand sink. 

Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure facility is monitoring/replacing caulking as needed.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
